title: What You need to know about passport renewal dubai in 2023
content:
Published On: December 18, 2023Updated On: October 19, 2025

Understanding the Requirements: Passport Renewal in Dubai

Your passport holds more importance in the collection of your travel essentials than any object for surpassing the borders. It is a doorway to a world of feasibilities, a monument of freedom and discovery, and a tangible connection, linking you to your global citizenship. Thus, it permits you to visit other countries of your choice with the embracing of varied cultures and make connections with people from all over the world.  Renewing your passport in Dubai can be a hassle-free process if you are well-equipped. That is why understanding the necessities thoroughly are important before you go for the passport renewal Dubai process.

In this article, you will be preparing yourself with a detailed understanding of the requirements for passport renewal Dubai; you can transform this potential uncertain block into a smooth step towards heaven. So, let’s begin the journey of knowledge, dissecting the essentials of a hassle-free passport renewal UAE. Prepare to conquer the paperwork dragons and make the way for an unavoidable adventure.

Documents You Need for Passport Renewal in Dubai

Indeed, overlooking a single document can transform your excitement into an extremely long wait when requesting this document. Therefore, meticulous document gathering is not merely a formality; it is the foundation for a smooth and stress-free journey. By ensuring you have everything in order, you avoid the soul-crushing delays and frantic last-minute dashes that can turn your dream vacation into a logistical nightmare.

Moreover, gathering all the documents well in advance grants you invaluable peace of mind. Knowing you are prepared eliminates the constant niggling worry of forgotten paperwork, as a result, allowing you to truly savor the pre-travel excitement. Pack your bags with anticipation, not anxiety, and let the countdown to your adventure begin.

Valid Original Passport

The original passport acts as your foremost identification document that contains your photo, biographic information, and unique passport number. The verification of these official documents are made to make sure whether you are the rightful owner of the passport or not.

Your passport serves as official proof of your nationality, recognized internationally. Therefore, this information is vital for processing your renewal application and ensuring you comply with any visa or travel requirements of your destination country. The passport often contains visas and immigration stamps from previous travels. Consequently, these entries help authorities verify your travel history and assess any potential security concerns.

Presenting your original valid passport confirms that your existing passport has not expired. In fact, renewing an expired passport requires a different process and may involve additional fees or delays. Also, requiring the original passport helps prevent fraud and misuse. By physically verifying the document, authorities can ensure it has not been tampered with or altered in any way.

Emirates ID Copy

Since it contains your photo, name, nationality, date of birth, and most importantly, your Emirates ID number, your Emirates ID serves as official evidence of your residency in Dubai.  This unique number connects you to the national database and confirms your legal status in the country. Also, it shows your current visa status in the UAE. This information is importance for authorities to state your eligibility for passport renewal Dubai. For instance, certain visa types might have specific requirements or restrictions regarding passport renewal Dubai.

It contains your registered address and contact details in Dubai. This information helps authorities to connect with you along with the processing of renewal of passport. This further, ensures you receive updates related to your passport application.

This information assists authorities to interact with you throughout the renewal process and ensures you receive updates and notifications related to your application. Providing a copy of your Emirates ID can expedite the renewal process. For instance, some service centers might utilize the information on your ID to pre-fill parts of the application form, saving you time and effort.

In some cases, authorities might use the information on your Emirates ID to conduct additional checks and verifications. This could involve cross-referencing data with other government databases or contacting your employer for confirmation of employment status.

Proof of Residence

Depending on your nationality and visa type, authorities might need to confirm your current residency in Dubai before processing your passport renewal UAE. Proof of residence can help establish this, particularly if your Emirates ID does not reflect your actual address. For example, as a Proof of Residence you can submit the following documents:

Emirates ID: As it is aforementioned, your ID can serve as proof of residence if your address is updated and precise.

Utility Bills: To accept as a proof of residence, recent electricity, water, or internet bills with your name and address can be utilized.

Tenancy Agreement: In case of renting a property in Dubai, a copy of your valid tenancy agreement can be asked.

Employer Confirmation: If the company you are associated with issues residency sponsorship, they might provide a document confirming your employment and address in Dubai.

What to Do If Your Passport Renewal Faces Delays?

Facing postponements in your passport renewal process Dubai can be confusing and disrupt your travel plans. Whereas, knowing how to handle and who to reach out can help you pacify the situation effectively and hopefully accelerate the process. Thinkable reasons for delays include high application volume, incomplete documentation, verification issues, or technical problems.

Stay in touch with the authorities, keeping records of communication. You must respond promptly to any questions or to clarify any type of additional information. Proactive communication shows you are actively engaged in resolving the issue. Passport renewal involves legal and security procedures. While frustrating, delays are sometimes unavoidable. Be patient, understand the limitations, and keep yourself updated on progress and any relevant changes in regulations.

Remember, a delayed passport renewal does not mean a canceled trip. By staying calm, communicating effectively, and exploring all available options, you can increase your chances of expediting the process and getting your travel back on track. Next, we will describe some steps you can take:

Check Application Status

To check the status of your Dubai passport renewal online application, you can use one of the following methods:

  • GDRFA Smart Services Portal: This is the official online portal of the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) for various services, including passport renewal online tracking. You will be required to have your application reference number or Emirates ID number to access the portal. This number is the highly essential piece of information for tracking your application. It is usually given on the confirmation receipt you received when you submitted your application.
  • Amer service: If you are an expatriate resident in Dubai, you can contact the Amer service on the toll-free number 800 5111. They can provide you with information about your passport application status over the phone.
  • GDRFA Contact Center: You can call the GDRFA Contact Center at +971 800 5111 for further inquiries and guidance with tracking your passport renewal Dubai application.

Despite that, you can always visit any of the designated Emirates ID and Passport Service Centers in Dubai and ask about your application status in person.

Alternative Travel Options

When you face a chaos with a delayed passport renewal and pending travel plans, going for substitute travel options can be the help you look for. Here are some potential solutions to consider, depending on your particular circumstances:

  • Temporary Travel Document (TTD): TTD Issued by your embassy or consulate, allows you to travel to specific countries for urgent reasons. Processing times can be quicker than a full passport renewal UAE, but validity period and destinations may be restricted to few.
  • Expedited Passport Renewal: Some countries offer expedited passport renewal Dubai services for urgent cases, potentially reducing processing time. Be prepared for higher fees and limited availability.
  • Travel Agency Assistance: Travel agencies can also help navigate emergency situations and explore alternative travel options you might not be aware of. Seek their expertise for personalized guidance.

Always prioritize official channels and authorized sources for information about emergency travel documents and visa requirements. Consider the cost, processing time, and validity limitations of each option before making a decision. Remain calm and proactive. By exploring alternative solutions and communicating effectively with authorities, you can increase your chances of finding a suitable travel option despite the passport delay.

Document Verification Assistance

This refers to the process of resolving any issues or discrepancies related to the documents submitted for your passport renewal application. Indeed, this can involve several steps depending on the specific reason for the delay:

Identifying the issue:

  1. Missing documents: The authorities might request additional documents or clarification on existing ones.
  2. Incomplete information: Gaps or inconsistencies in your application details might need rectifying.
  3. Discrepancies: Information in your submitted documents might not match official records or raise red flags for verification.

Gathering supporting documents:

  • Obtain missing documents from relevant sources like educational institutions or employers.
  • Collect additional documentation to support or clarify the information in your application.
  • Translate documents into Arabic if required by the authorities.

Submitting the required information:

  • Use official channels like the GDRFA Smart Services Portal or designated service centers.
  • Contact your embassy or consulate for assistance with nationality-related documents.
  • Consider authorized service providers for complex cases or if navigating official channels proves challenging.
  • Maintain communication with the authorities regarding the verification process. Also, provide timely responses to requests for additional information or clarifications. Follow up regularly on the status of your application and address any pending issues.

Why Timely Passport Renewal Matters?

Timely passport renewal Dubai is highly important for several reasons, making sure of a smooth and stress-free travel experience. Here are some significant advantages:

Avoids Travel Disruptions:

Upon expiring the passport, you might face to missed flights, canceled vacations, and unforeseen delays in your travel plans.  The renewal within time ensures to provide with a valid document before your trip, avoiding last-minute chaos and disappointment.

However, some countries demands visa to be valid for specific period beyond your traveling dates for visa processing. Expired passports can create delays or even rejection of your visa application, disturbing your travel plans.

Peace of Mind and Flexibility:

Knowing your passport is valid and readily available brings peace of mind while traveling. You can focus on enjoying your trip without worrying about potential passport issues or missed opportunities.

Timely renewal opens doors to unexpected travel opportunities. This gives you ease to make last-minute plans and explore your best-liked destination without the passport stopping you back.

Financial Savings:

Delaying renewal too close to your travel date can force you to opt for expedited processing, which often comes with higher fees. Timely renewal allows you to choose standard processing options, saving you money.

On the other hand, expired passports can lead to missed out on time-sensitive travel deals and promotions requiring immediate booking. Renewing in advance ensures you can take advantage of such opportunities without facing last-minute limitations.

Emergency Situations:

Unforeseen emergencies, like a family medical situation abroad, might require immediate travel. Having a valid passport readily available allows you to respond quickly and effectively to emergencies.

Maintaining Legal Compliance:

Some countries may deny entry or impose fines for travelers with expired passports. Timely renewal ensures you comply with legal requirements and avoid potential hassles at immigration checkpoints, even if your visa is valid.

Choosing the Right Service through Us

In conclusion, getting a timely passport renewal not only provides a official valid document for travel, but also comes with the peace of mind, flexibility, financial savings and legal acquaintances.  Opting for this simple task, will open doors of traveling across the globe for you with the hassle-free journey.

Living and working in Dubai is itself a privilege, being the hub of opportunities. But things get escalated to difficulty quickly when the passport renewal gets involved. The maze of paperwork, deadlines, and conflicting information can leave even the most seasoned professional feeling lost. Connect to us, we are here to assist you through the process with ease and efficiency.

Remember, it is suggested to renew your passport at least 6 months before its expiry to avoid any potential delays or complexities. Make timely renewal a habit and enjoy the freedom and peace of mind that comes with a valid passport in hand. Understanding the Requirements: Passport Renewal in Dubai

Your passport holds more importance in the collection of your travel essentials than any object for surpassing the borders. It is a doorway to a world of feasibilities, a monument of freedom and discovery, and a tangible connection, linking you to your global citizenship. Thus, it permits you to visit other countries of your choice with the embracing of varied cultures and make connections with people from all over the world.  Renewing your passport in Dubai can be a hassle-free process if you are well-equipped. That is why understanding the necessities thoroughly are important before you go for the passport renewal Dubai process.

In this article, you will be preparing yourself with a detailed understanding of the requirements for passport renewal Dubai; you can transform this potential uncertain block into a smooth step towards heaven. So, let’s begin the journey of knowledge, dissecting the essentials of a hassle-free passport renewal UAE. Prepare to conquer the paperwork dragons and make the way for an unavoidable adventure.

Documents You Need for Passport Renewal in Dubai

Indeed, overlooking a single document can transform your excitement into an extremely long wait when requesting this document. Therefore, meticulous document gathering is not merely a formality; it is the foundation for a smooth and stress-free journey. By ensuring you have everything in order, you avoid the soul-crushing delays and frantic last-minute dashes that can turn your dream vacation into a logistical nightmare.

Moreover, gathering all the documents well in advance grants you invaluable peace of mind. Knowing you are prepared eliminates the constant niggling worry of forgotten paperwork, as a result, allowing you to truly savor the pre-travel excitement. Pack your bags with anticipation, not anxiety, and let the countdown to your adventure begin.

Valid Original Passport

The original passport acts as your foremost identification document that contains your photo, biographic information, and unique passport number. The verification of these official documents are made to make sure whether you are the rightful owner of the passport or not.

Your passport serves as official proof of your nationality, recognized internationally. Therefore, this information is vital for processing your renewal application and ensuring you comply with any visa or travel requirements of your destination country. The passport often contains visas and immigration stamps from previous travels. Consequently, these entries help authorities verify your travel history and assess any potential security concerns.

Presenting your original valid passport confirms that your existing passport has not expired. In fact, renewing an expired passport requires a different process and may involve additional fees or delays. Also, requiring the original passport helps prevent fraud and misuse. By physically verifying the document, authorities can ensure it has not been tampered with or altered in any way.

Emirates ID Copy

Since it contains your photo, name, nationality, date of birth, and most importantly, your Emirates ID number, your Emirates ID serves as official evidence of your residency in Dubai.  This unique number connects you to the national database and confirms your legal status in the country. Also, it shows your current visa status in the UAE. This information is importance for authorities to state your eligibility for passport renewal Dubai. For instance, certain visa types might have specific requirements or restrictions regarding passport renewal Dubai.

It contains your registered address and contact details in Dubai. This information helps authorities to connect with you along with the processing of renewal of passport. This further, ensures you receive updates related to your passport application.

This information assists authorities to interact with you throughout the renewal process and ensures you receive updates and notifications related to your application. Providing a copy of your Emirates ID can expedite the renewal process. For instance, some service centers might utilize the information on your ID to pre-fill parts of the application form, saving you time and effort.

In some cases, authorities might use the information on your Emirates ID to conduct additional checks and verifications. This could involve cross-referencing data with other government databases or contacting your employer for confirmation of employment status.

Proof of Residence

Depending on your nationality and visa type, authorities might need to confirm your current residency in Dubai before processing your passport renewal UAE. Proof of residence can help establish this, particularly if your Emirates ID does not reflect your actual address. For example, as a Proof of Residence you can submit the following documents:

Emirates ID: As it is aforementioned, your ID can serve as proof of residence if your address is updated and precise.

Utility Bills: To accept as a proof of residence, recent electricity, water, or internet bills with your name and address can be utilized.

Tenancy Agreement: In case of renting a property in Dubai, a copy of your valid tenancy agreement can be asked.

Employer Confirmation: If the company you are associated with issues residency sponsorship, they might provide a document confirming your employment and address in Dubai.

What to Do If Your Passport Renewal Faces Delays?

Facing postponements in your passport renewal process Dubai can be confusing and disrupt your travel plans. Whereas, knowing how to handle and who to reach out can help you pacify the situation effectively and hopefully accelerate the process. Thinkable reasons for delays include high application volume, incomplete documentation, verification issues, or technical problems.

Stay in touch with the authorities, keeping records of communication. You must respond promptly to any questions or to clarify any type of additional information. Proactive communication shows you are actively engaged in resolving the issue. Passport renewal involves legal and security procedures. While frustrating, delays are sometimes unavoidable. Be patient, understand the limitations, and keep yourself updated on progress and any relevant changes in regulations.

Remember, a delayed passport renewal does not mean a canceled trip. By staying calm, communicating effectively, and exploring all available options, you can increase your chances of expediting the process and getting your travel back on track. Next, we will describe some steps you can take:

Check Application Status

To check the status of your Dubai passport renewal online application, you can use one of the following methods:

  • GDRFA Smart Services Portal: This is the official online portal of the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) for various services, including passport renewal online tracking. You will be required to have your application reference number or Emirates ID number to access the portal. This number is the highly essential piece of information for tracking your application. It is usually given on the confirmation receipt you received when you submitted your application.
  • Amer service: If you are an expatriate resident in Dubai, you can contact the Amer service on the toll-free number 800 5111. They can provide you with information about your passport application status over the phone.
  • GDRFA Contact Center: You can call the GDRFA Contact Center at +971 800 5111 for further inquiries and guidance with tracking your passport renewal Dubai application.

Despite that, you can always visit any of the designated Emirates ID and Passport Service Centers in Dubai and ask about your application status in person.

Alternative Travel Options

When you face a chaos with a delayed passport renewal and pending travel plans, going for substitute travel options can be the help you look for. Here are some potential solutions to consider, depending on your particular circumstances:

  • Temporary Travel Document (TTD): TTD Issued by your embassy or consulate, allows you to travel to specific countries for urgent reasons. Processing times can be quicker than a full passport renewal UAE, but validity period and destinations may be restricted to few.
  • Expedited Passport Renewal: Some countries offer expedited passport renewal Dubai services for urgent cases, potentially reducing processing time. Be prepared for higher fees and limited availability.
  • Travel Agency Assistance: Travel agencies can also help navigate emergency situations and explore alternative travel options you might not be aware of. Seek their expertise for personalized guidance.

Always prioritize official channels and authorized sources for information about emergency travel documents and visa requirements. Consider the cost, processing time, and validity limitations of each option before making a decision. Remain calm and proactive. By exploring alternative solutions and communicating effectively with authorities, you can increase your chances of finding a suitable travel option despite the passport delay.

Document Verification Assistance

This refers to the process of resolving any issues or discrepancies related to the documents submitted for your passport renewal application. Indeed, this can involve several steps depending on the specific reason for the delay:

Identifying the issue:

  1. Missing documents: The authorities might request additional documents or clarification on existing ones.
  2. Incomplete information: Gaps or inconsistencies in your application details might need rectifying.
  3. Discrepancies: Information in your submitted documents might not match official records or raise red flags for verification.

Gathering supporting documents:

  • Obtain missing documents from relevant sources like educational institutions or employers.
  • Collect additional documentation to support or clarify the information in your application.
  • Translate documents into Arabic if required by the authorities.

Submitting the required information:

  • Use official channels like the GDRFA Smart Services Portal or designated service centers.
  • Contact your embassy or consulate for assistance with nationality-related documents.
  • Consider authorized service providers for complex cases or if navigating official channels proves challenging.
  • Maintain communication with the authorities regarding the verification process. Also, provide timely responses to requests for additional information or clarifications. Follow up regularly on the status of your application and address any pending issues.

Why Timely Passport Renewal Matters?

Timely passport renewal Dubai is highly important for several reasons, making sure of a smooth and stress-free travel experience. Here are some significant advantages:

Avoids Travel Disruptions:

Upon expiring the passport, you might face to missed flights, canceled vacations, and unforeseen delays in your travel plans.  The renewal within time ensures to provide with a valid document before your trip, avoiding last-minute chaos and disappointment.

However, some countries demands visa to be valid for specific period beyond your traveling dates for visa processing. Expired passports can create delays or even rejection of your visa application, disturbing your travel plans.

Peace of Mind and Flexibility:

Knowing your passport is valid and readily available brings peace of mind while traveling. You can focus on enjoying your trip without worrying about potential passport issues or missed opportunities.

Timely renewal opens doors to unexpected travel opportunities. This gives you ease to make last-minute plans and explore your best-liked destination without the passport stopping you back.

Financial Savings:

Delaying renewal too close to your travel date can force you to opt for expedited processing, which often comes with higher fees. Timely renewal allows you to choose standard processing options, saving you money.

On the other hand, expired passports can lead to missed out on time-sensitive travel deals and promotions requiring immediate booking. Renewing in advance ensures you can take advantage of such opportunities without facing last-minute limitations.

Emergency Situations:

Unforeseen emergencies, like a family medical situation abroad, might require immediate travel. Having a valid passport readily available allows you to respond quickly and effectively to emergencies.

Maintaining Legal Compliance:

Some countries may deny entry or impose fines for travelers with expired passports. Timely renewal ensures you comply with legal requirements and avoid potential hassles at immigration checkpoints, even if your visa is valid.

Choosing the Right Service through Us

In conclusion, getting a timely passport renewal not only provides a official valid document for travel, but also comes with the peace of mind, flexibility, financial savings and legal acquaintances.  Opting for this simple task, will open doors of traveling across the globe for you with the hassle-free journey.

Living and working in Dubai is itself a privilege, being the hub of opportunities. But things get escalated to difficulty quickly when the passport renewal gets involved. The maze of paperwork, deadlines, and conflicting information can leave even the most seasoned professional feeling lost. Connect to us, we are here to assist you through the process with ease and efficiency.

Remember, it is suggested to renew your passport at least 6 months before its expiry to avoid any potential delays or complexities. Make timely renewal a habit and enjoy the freedom and peace of mind that comes with a valid passport in hand. If you want to read more information about the process of official documents in the UAE, go to our insights page.

title: All You Must Know About Paternity Leave in UAE
content:
Published On: February 14, 2024Updated On: November 26, 2025

Parenting Guide: Everything About Paternity Leave in the UAE

Parenthood takes you on a journey of great joy. This immense level of joy comes with a greater responsibility. Recently UAE has seen the concept of paternity leave introduced reflecting an overall social change on the country’s part.

Paternity leave in UAE recognize fathers’ role in the upbringing of children. Understanding one’s rights contributes to a balanced family life.

NG Manpower has penned down this piece to explain your rights, leave duration, and recent amendments in the UAE labor law.

What are the UAE’s rights regarding paternity leave?

Paternity leave, a legal provision for fathers to bond with their newborns, is a crucial aspect of work-life balance. In the UAE, it is imperative to extend this privilege to male employees.

Overall, employees within the government sector enjoy the benefit of paid paternity leave in UAE. However until 2020, there were no such provisions for those working in the private sector. In 2020, Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan directed an adjustment to the UAE Labour Law, marking a significant change.

This adjustment positioned the UAE as the first Middle Eastern country to grant paternity leave in UAE for fathers in the private sector. This noteworthy development, unveiled in September 2020, aligns with the UAE’s commitment to gender equality.

What is the UAE’s Paternity Leave Duration?

Male employees now get five days of paid leave within the first six months of the child’s birth. Interestingly, regular weekends are not a part of the paternity leave.

What new labor laws in the UAE cover maternity leave?

New labour laws in UAE saw these changes in maternity leave:

  • Total duration of maternity has been extended from 45 to 60 days
  • Women are entitled to full pay for the initial 45 days
  • They are also entitled to half pay for the next 15 days

Mothers with children needing continuous medical attention and are provided with 30 days leave for full pay that is extendable for another 30 days

Nursing Breaks Duration

The previous law granted 18 months following delivery whereas the amended law has limited it to six months post delivery instead

Benefits of Paternity leave in the UAE

Paternity leave in UAE support employees in the following ways:

  • Full Pay Assurance: Fathers are entitled to receive full pay during their paternity leave days.
  • Salary Deduction Prohibition: Employers are explicitly prohibited from making any deductions from an employee’s salary for parental leave.
  • Equality in Multiple Births: The law remains steadfast even in the case of multiple births.

This supportive approach reflects the UAE’s commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being. Fathers, being active participants in the early stages of parenting, experience enhanced job satisfaction and overall work-life harmony.

In conclusion, the benefits of leave in UAE extend beyond personal advantages, positively impacting workplace culture and gender dynamics. The progressive labor laws demonstrate the UAE’s dedication to a holistic and equitable approach in fostering family-friendly workplaces.

Why Paternity Leave Matters in the Workplace

  • Paternity leave in UAE is more than just a legal entitlement, it is a catalyst for positive workplace dynamics.
  • Businesses gain a competitive edge.
  • Paternity leave in UAE during the probation period is a unique aspect that reflects the nation’s commitment to family values.

Paternity Leave Entitlements for Multiple Births in the UAE

Understanding paternity leave in UAE is essential for fathers, and this extends to scenarios involving multiple births. All fathers in the UAE, irrespective of the number of children, are entitled to paternity leave. However, it is crucial to note a time limitation.

The law remains consistent when it comes to multiple births. Regardless of whether a father is expecting one child or more, the paternity leave entitlement remains fixed at five days of fully paid leave.

In conclusion, the UAE’s approach to paternity leave in UAE for fathers, especially in the context of multiple births, demonstrates a commitment to fairness and inclusivity. Fathers, regardless of circumstances, can embrace their role with the assurance of support and understanding from both the legal framework and their employers.

Paternity Leave’s Role in Gender Balance

Fathers actively participate in childcare through paternity leave in UAE creating a harmonious partnership. This shared responsibility reduces the burden on mothers, promoting a more equitable distribution of caregiving duties.

Incorporating paternity leave in UAE for private sector employees strengthens the commitment to gender-neutral policies. This inclusivity sends a powerful message that parenting responsibilities are actually a shared endeavor.

The impact of paternity leave in UAE extends beyond the familial sphere.

Final Thoughts

As we delve deeper into the paternity leave in UAE for father, it is evident that this provision goes beyond mere days off work. It symbolizes a commitment to fostering equal responsibilities in parenting, thereby fortifying familial relationships.

Paternity leave in UAE works for gender balance, work-life balance and a balanced family life. If you look at the bigger picture, all these benefits contribute to UAE’s economy.

Finally, as we navigate the nuanced landscape of modern parenthood, the significance of paternity leave in UAE remains a beacon.

UAE has made a great change. Want to know more about paternity leaves in the UAE, head to our insights section. Got any questions for us? Call us on +971 43 316 688 or email us at contact@ngmanpower.com.

FAQs

How many days of paternity leave do fathers get in the UAE?

In the UAE, fathers are entitled to five days of fully paid paternity leave. The leaves can be taken within six months of the child’s birth.

Is paternity leave still applicable if the child is born outside the UAE?

Yes. Paternity leave applies even if the child is born abroad, as long as the father works for a UAE-registered company.

What are the rules for paternity leave for fathers?

Fathers can take five consecutive or separate paid days. They’re permitted to take leave within six months of childbirth. The leave must be approved by the employer in advance.

 Is paternity leave in the UAE paid or unpaid?

The UAE paternity leaves are fully paid. Being a father, your employer cannot deduct any portion of your salary during paternity leave as per the UAE labour law.

Can both parents take leave together after childbirth in the UAE?

Yes. Both parents can take their respective leaves simultaneously. UAE labor law grants new mothers maternity leave and the new father paternity leave. These leaves are provided to support shared parenting.

Are private and government employees offered the same paternity leave benefits in the UAE?

Government employees often enjoy longer or extended benefits. However, private sector fathers are legally entitled to five days of paid leave. This shall be granted under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.

title: Probation period in UAE
content:
Published On: March 20, 2024Updated On: November 6, 2025

Probation period in UAE – Your Ultimate Guide of Employment Laws

The probation period in the UAE is mandatory for all employees, regardless of the industry where they work. From employees in the construction sector to those who work in executive roles, everyone has to comply with probation.

In this article, you are going to learn more about the probation period UAE. Moreover, you will see the rights and responsibilities as well as the duration and extension rules of the probation period in Dubai.

Rights and Responsibilities during probation period

Regardless if the employee is working under a limited or unlimited contract, an employer can place them on probation. This is in accordance with the UAE Labor Law. And, this period starts once the employee begins to work for the company.

During this probation period, the employer will assess the employee’s performance to determine if he or she is a good fit for the role. As such, the employee has to undergo through the following:

  • Evaluation and performance screening.
  • Regular feedback.
  • Clarifications about the role.

It is important to point out that the employee will still receive their payment during probation. And, once the MOHRE probation period finishes, the employer will decide if the employee is suitable for a permanent position at the company or not.

In terms of rights and responsibilities, the following are according to the law:

  • Customer service training (if applicable)

title: Salary Advance Request Letter: Format & Key Parts
content:
Published On: May 31, 2024Updated On: January 23, 2026

Salary Advance Request Letter Format and Essential Components

Financial aid is requested through the salary advance request letter and this has become a norm in today’s volatile work setting. However, even in terms of monetary stability, unexpected incidents may prompt an individual to desire a salary advance. There are uncertainties in life that require urgent solutions and employees will not hesitate to walk into their future employer’s office demanding a short-term financial relief.

In this article, let us take a closer look at the crucial elements of an efficient letter. Second, we will make sure that your request is not only understood by the employer but also evaluated positively. With the knowledge of how to ask for a salary advance, people can articulate their needs in front of employers without violating standards.

What to Include in Your Salary Advance Request Letter

A salary advance request letter is sent so as to appeal for a salary in advance. In certain instances, employees may be compelled to take an advance in salaries and due to either a medical or personal reason. In your letter, you should follow the standard format for a formal one because of its precision and foresight.

  • Begin with simple details such as the address, date of issue and destination. Make it clear how much money you require and explain why an early, or advance, salary is appropriate in your case. It should be a formal, lowly one throughout the letter.
  • As a leave application, the advance salary request letter UAE needs to be also detailed. The body of the letter should encompass things such as: The information concerning the necessary amount and purpose is indicated in a simple form like an address, date of writing as well as other details for your recipient.
  • By adopting this systematic way of doing things, employees have an opportunity to communicate the need for a salary advance and increase their chances of seeking such favors from employers. In reality, a concise letter helps in clear communication of financial needs as well making its transmission systematic and business like.
  • Finally, developing an effective salary advance request letter entails emphasis on details and clarity of language used as well as using formal tone. For this reason, it is an application whose sense of urgency and professionalism needs to be put into consideration.

Proposed Repayment Plan

Creating a great detailed salary advance request letter is necessitated by undertaking an exhaustive analysis of your proposed repayment plan. So, the repayment plan can be viewed as a pillar signaling your dedication to full and timely payment of financial obligations.

  • In the main part of your letter, state what action you will take to pay back the advanced salary. This phase is fundamental in ensuring that reassurance to your boss of the financial responsibility. First, it is necessary to state the specific plans you have with regards to repaying in a given time frame.
  • Going into details, indicate the frequency and form of repayment. Irrespective of whether it is deducted monthly or paid through a single reimbursement, clarity in the employees’ communication should always be emphasized.

This not only makes the processing easier, but it also reflects your proactive nature to resolve the financial arrangement. Additionally, capitalize on this occasion to highlight the adaptability of your suggested plan.

  • Recognize that financial situations rarely stay the same, and be willing to change repayment terms if needed. Flexibility shows your awareness of the challenges that may come up during settling.

Wrapping-up this part, reiterate your willingness to comply with the suggested repayment plan. Emphasize that your desire to receive a salary advance is not merely concerned with getting money but making the right decision about undertaking debt for such an amount.

The evidence of forward thinking and dependability concerning the repayment plan noticeably increases the chances of a positive response for your request letter for salary advance.

Providing Essential Details

When developing a salary advance request letter sample it is crucial to provide all the necessary information. This in order to ensure clarity and make things smoother, for example:

  • Date: Firstly, date the beginning of your correspondence with the current day and establish a temporal frame for what follows.
  • Employee Information: Make sure that you provide your full name as well job title, department and employee ID number. This information allows to identify and process your request correctly.
  • Employer Information: Add the name and address of your employer and set an official tone for the letter.
  • Purpose of the Request: Provide a brief statement as to why you are requesting an advance on your wages. Transparency is key.
  • Amount Requested: Be specific as to the amount of the salary advance you are asking for. This removes any uncertainty and ensures precise execution.
  • Payment Plan: Although an advance salary usually does not need to be reimbursed, some employers may respond favorably if you add a short explanation about how and when, assuming it applies in your case.
  • Acknowledgement: Start with an admission clause recognizing that the advance is not a loan and may or may not be repaid.
  • Signature: At the end of your salary advance request letter, type in and print out your signature name. This formalizes your request and authenticates its validity.

Highlighting the Reason for the Salary Advance

Transparency concerning the objective is a requirement when writing your salary advance request letter. Establish the details behind what triggered your requirement for financial aid.

Dubai is a busy city noted for unforeseen monetary challenges emerging, which come as grounds to send an advance salary request letter UAE. From unexpected health to emergency home repairs, the uncertainties of life take their toll on your financial balance.

  • Start your letter with a brief summary of the reason you want to receive an advance. If it concerns situations related to health issues, give a short overview of the issue making sure your employer understands that there is an emergency without elaborating too many details.
  • Smoothly move on to the effect these circumstances had on your financial security. Emphasize the transient nature of your downfall and that a salaried advance would be timely, alleviating this challenge without compromising financial obligations.
  • Wrap up this section by restating that you will keep your professional duties. Inform your employer that the salary advance is just a temporary measure to get over an unexpected barrier but assure them you will be on top of fulfilling your duties promptly.

Basically, clarity and transparency are your friends in the delivery of why you need an advance on salary through a letter. Note that a clear and logical rationale promotes understanding and collaboration.

Addressing Health-Related Financial Needs

In times of unforeseen health crises, crafting a compelling salary advance request letter becomes imperative. So, here is a detailed guide on addressing health-related financial needs in your letter:

  • Expressing Urgency: Begin by clearly articulating the urgency of your situation. Use a respectful tone to convey the gravity of your health-related financial needs.
  • Detailing Medical Expenses: Provide a breakdown of the medical expenses you’re facing. Transparency is essential to help your employer understand the financial burden.

What is a Salary Certificate in the UAE? An Ultimate Guide

A salary certificate is more than just a piece of paper. Serving as evidence for income and employment, this document is mandatory for employees and employers in the UAE. It is an integral part of the legal and financial regulations. Reflecting personal and professional transactions, this is an indispensable tool in professional and personal transactions.

Explore this guide to delve into its significance. Know how to get one, what should be included in it, and suggestions to ensure its validity, with updated 2025 insights.

What is a salary certificate?

A salary certificate is an official document issued by an employer, detailing an employee’s job title, salary breakdown, and employment status. It is different from payslips which showcase the detailed breakdown of a specific month’s salary.  On the other hand, a salary certificate confirms the employment condition and finances status.

Why is it important in the UAE?

Holding prominent importance in the UAE, a salary certificate serves as a cornerstone of various official and financial dealings. It confirms the employment status and income which is a facilitated measure for both employers and employees.

As an employer

Being an employer of any organization, it is their obligation to issue a salary certificate to the employee with all the standard formalities. It is declared mandatory as per the regulations of UAE’s labor law. Not only does it promote transparency between both parties but also maintains trust. 

As an employee

For employees, a salary certificate is essential for various personal and professional transactions. This document accurately states the financial credibility that can be showcased when applying for a credit card to secure a visa.

How to obtain a salary certificate in the UAE

From manual requests to digital platforms, it is now easier to obtain a salary certificate in the UAE. Follow the breakdown of simplified steps and experience a seamless procedure.

Requesting from your HR department

Most companies in the UAE have a straightforward process for obtaining a salary certificate. Employees can submit a formal request, either via email or through an internal HR portal. The HR department typically issues the certificate within a few working days, customized as per the purpose mentioned in the request.

Self-declaration

Some workers who are freelancers or consultants do not have to obtain a salary certificate as mandatory. However, they can generate the draft for self-declaration of income and keep a record for themselves. Also, it can be provided as an alternative to bank statements or invoices. 

How to get salary certificate online UAE

Many organizations now offer online portals where employees can download or request a salary certificate directly. This option ensures quicker processing and reduces paperwork, aligning with the UAE’s vision of digital transformation.

Common uses of a salary certificate in the UAE

A salary certificate serves many official purposes in many cases. It caters to both personal and professional requirements in the UAE.  A few of the areas and domains are highlighted below that can ask for a salary certificate. 

Visa and residency permits

Immigration authorities also require salary certificates oftentimes when applying for or renewing visas for family members or dependents. It showcases the financial stability of the applicant, a key criterion for visa approvals.

Bank loans and credit cards

Banks in the UAE also ask to present a salary certificate to estimate the individual’s eligibility for loans or credit cards. They make sure the applicant is capable of repayment obligations.

Real estate transactions

Salary certificates also play an important role in real estate dealing. If you rent an apartment or any place, you will be asked to verify your income and employment status. This document confirms all the details to the landlord and real estate agent, verifying the applicant’s financial capacity.

Personal loans

Financial institutions require a salary certificate to process personal loan applications. It helps determine the loan amount an individual qualifies for based on their income.

Format of salary certificate in the UAE

A salary certificate in the UAE typically includes the following details:

  1. Company Name and Logo
  2. Employee Name and Job Title
  3. Monthly/Annual Salary
  4. Date of Joining
  5. Employment Status (Permanent/Contractual)
  6. Purpose of the Certificate
  7. Authorized Signature and Stamp

Sample Salary Certificate:

[Company Letterhead]
Date: [Insert Date]

To whom it may concern

This is to attest that [Employee’s Full Name], working for the position of [Job Title], has been employed with [Company Name] since [Date of Joining]. The details of their salary are as follows:

  • Basic Salary: [Amount]
  • Allowances: [Amount]
  • Gross Salary: [Amount]

This certificate is issued upon the request of the employee for [Purpose of the Certificate].

Yours faithfully,
[Authorized Signatory Name]
[Designation]
[Company Stamp]

Tips for ensuring a valid salary certificate UAE

To ensure that a salary certificate is valid and accepted by relevant authorities, both employers and employees must adhere to specific guidelines during its preparation and issuance.

Official letterhead

Ensure that the salary certificate is printed on the official letterhead of the company. This adds authenticity and credibility to the document.

Accurate information

Verify that all details, such as the employee’s name, salary, and job title, are accurate. Any discrepancies can lead to delays or rejection by the requesting entity.

Authorized signature

The HR manager or any unauthorized person in the company is required to sign this official document. It becomes invalid if the document is unsigned.

Company stamp

A company stamp is mandatory on salary certificates in the UAE. It serves as an official seal, confirming the authenticity of the document.

Secure storage

Both employers and employees should securely store issued salary certificates to prevent loss or misuse. Digital copies can be an additional backup.

Wrapping up

The salary certificate is an unavoidable formality of employment for both concerned authorities of the companies and its workers. Whether you are the one issuing the salary certificate or accepting it, this certificate strengthens the financial dealings without any doubt or inaccuracies. This authentic element can be used for professional purposes ahead. However, as per the standard format described in this guide, make sure that your certificate has all the information. In this digital period, it is more than easy to obtain a salary certificate for any HR person, making things time-efficient.

A salary certificate serves many official purposes in many cases. It caters to both personal and professional requirements in the UAE.  A few of the areas and domains are highlighted below that can ask for a salary certificate. 

Visa and residency permits

Immigration authorities also require salary certificates oftentimes when applying for or renewing visas for family members or dependents. It showcases the financial stability of the applicant, a key criterion for visa approvals.

Bank loans and credit cards

Banks in the UAE also ask to present a salary certificate to estimate the individual’s eligibility for loans or credit cards. They make sure the applicant is capable of repayment obligations.

Real estate transactions

Salary certificates also play an important role in real estate dealing. If you rent an apartment or any place, you will be asked to verify your income and employment status. This document confirms all the details to the landlord and real estate agent, verifying the applicant’s financial capacity.

Personal loans

Financial institutions require a salary certificate to process personal loan applications. It helps determine the loan amount an individual qualifies for based on their income.

Format of salary certificate in the UAE

A salary certificate in the UAE typically includes the following details:

  1. Company Name and Logo
  2. Employee Name and Job Title
  3. Monthly/Annual Salary
  4. Date of Joining
  5. Employment Status (Permanent/Contractual)
  6. Purpose of the Certificate
  7. Authorized Signature and Stamp

Sample Salary Certificate:

[Company Letterhead]
Date: [Insert Date]

To whom it may concern

This is to attest that [Employee’s Full Name], working for the position of [Job Title], has been employed with [Company Name] since [Date of Joining]. The details of their salary are as follows:

  • Basic Salary: [Amount]
  • Allowances: [Amount]
  • Gross Salary: [Amount]

This certificate is issued upon the request of the employee for [Purpose of the Certificate].

Yours faithfully,
[Authorized Signatory Name]
[Designation]
[Company Stamp]

Tips for ensuring a valid salary certificate UAE

To ensure that a salary certificate is valid and accepted by relevant authorities, both employers and employees must adhere to specific guidelines during its preparation and issuance.

Official letterhead

Ensure that the salary certificate is printed on the official letterhead of the company. This adds authenticity and credibility to the document.

Accurate information

Verify that all details, such as the employee’s name, salary, and job title, are accurate. Any discrepancies can lead to delays or rejection by the requesting entity.

Authorized signature

The HR manager or any unauthorized person in the company is required to sign this official document. It becomes invalid if the document is unsigned.

Company stamp

A company stamp is mandatory on salary certificates in the UAE. It serves as an official seal, confirming the authenticity of the document.

Secure storage

Both employers and employees should securely store issued salary certificates to prevent loss or misuse. Digital copies can be an additional backup.

Wrapping up

The salary certificate is an unavoidable formality of employment for both concerned authorities of the companies and its workers. Whether you are the one issuing the salary certificate or accepting it, this certificate strengthens the financial dealings without any doubt or inaccuracies. This authentic element can be used for professional purposes ahead. However, as per the standard format described in this guide, make sure that your certificate has all the information. In this digital period, it is more than easy to obtain a salary certificate for any HR person, making things time-efficient.

Salary Check UAE: Your Path to Financial Clarity

When you do a salary check UAE, you will be able to see how much your professional salary in the UAE is. Likewise, with clearer information, you will be able to see what salaries you can aspire to. In addition, working in the Emirates can be an excellent source of income due to the economic growth.

In this article, we will look at how salary is handled by labor law in the United Arab Emirates. Also, how you can be successful when looking for employment and a fair salary.

Exploring Salary Averages by Job Role

In the pay scale lookup online UAE, you will notice the difference in salaries by type of job. Moreover, a series of salary regulations support this as you will see below:

Salary Standards for Specific Job Titles

In the UAE there is no legal minimum wage nor in Abu Dhabi or Dubai. Consequently, to establish a minimum base salary, the employer and the employee may agree and reflect in an employment contract. Furthermore, it is important to do the check salary online UAE to know the salary averages.

In addition, the government indicates that for now it is not planned to apply a minimum wage, as stated by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization. However, local analysts state that the minimum wage by agreement in 2023 will be between AED 600 and AED 3,000 per month. Likewise, the amount will depend directly on the qualification of the employee and the company where he/she works.

Also, in Article 59 of the Emirati labor law, employees will not have to purchase their food or goods on the business of their employer. Similarly, the employer may not transfer wages from daily hourly or monthly wages to weekly wages. On the other hand, in Dubai, the minimum salary by agreement in 2023 is AED 16,500 per month.

However, this will depend on the training, experience, and qualifications of the employee. Furthermore, to set these salaries it will depend on the ability to negotiate and nationality. In comparison, a European will have a better salary than foreigners from Asia and Africa.

The average salary check UAE

Comparing Salaries Across Job Positions

Doing a salary check UAE to know what the average salary is can be simple but the salary the employee receives will depend on many factors. This way, some of these determining factors will be education, location, profession, and experience, among others. You will then be able to see the salary comparison based on these parameters.

Salary check UAE According to Profession

In Dubai, the salary will depend on key companies such as medicine, finance, and energy, among others. However, salaries within these companies vary depending on the profession or position held by the worker. See below the salary check UAE for the most common professions in Dubai:

Salary check UAE Average by Location

The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and the Emirates formed a political and economic alliance of the 6 countries that comprise it. In addition, they are second in GDP after Saudi Arabia, which leads to a competitive economy.

Likewise, the Emirate Dubai has a much better economy than the other emirates. Thus, it is the one with a salary of 10% above the rest of the UAE. That is, in this emirate an employee will earn a little more with the same profession than in the rest of the emirates. City and average salary (per month)

Education UAE salary check

Generally, a higher level of education will generate a better salary. Now, we will see the Online salary assessment in UAE in Dubai based on the educational level:

  • With a certificate or diploma, a worker will earn approximately 17% more than peers who only finished high school.
  • With a bachelor’s degree, the employee will earn 24% more than workers with a diploma or certificate.
  • Professionals with a Master’s degree earn 29% more than those with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • A doctorate. The holder earns the highest salary by earning more than 23% more than master’s degree holders for the same work.
Salary comparison by experience

In Dubai and the other emirates, your level of experience will also influence the salary you can receive. In addition, according to the online salary assessment in UAE carried out, the base salary that a person earns could double after exceeding 10 years of experience. Below is the salary breakdown in Dubai based on your experience:

Salary Check UAE by Years of Experience   and Average Salary Increase Rate

  • For 2 to 5 years of experience 32% more than newbies.
  • From 5 to 10 years, 36% more than professionals with less than 5 years of experience.
  • Between 10 and 15 years will receive an additional 21% compared to professionals with less than 10 years of experience.
  • From 15 to 20 years the employee will receive 14% more than professionals with 15 years of experience
  • Finally, those with more than 20 years of experience will receive 9% more than those who have only 15 years of experience.

Evaluating Role Compensation in the UAE

Labor law requires that to compensate for the set minimum wage, employers must provide their employees with some benefits. Next, you will see what these benefits are about:

  • Paid leave. You must grant your employees paid vacations in the first year and 30 days thereafter.
  • Travel expenses. The employer will guarantee the employee a return flight to his or her country once the employment contract has ended.
  • Health insurance. Once the trial period is over, the employer will provide health insurance to its employees.
  • The employer will pay end-of-service compensation after completing the terms of the employment contract. Likewise, the compensation may not be greater than the equivalent of a base salary for 20 months.

Tips for Negotiating Your UAE Salary

Below are some useful tips so you can negotiate your salary successfully:

Knowing Your Value in the UAE Labor Market

To find the pay scale lookup online UAE according to your needs, the first thing you have to know is what your value is as an employee. This includes your education, skills, and what your strengths are in the workplace. Furthermore, the CV you present must reflect all these factors clearly, so it is advisable to analyze qualities.

Likewise, do not skimp on exposing all the qualities you have, for them, you can consult with family, co-workers, and friends. In addition to this, observe the following:

Be proud of yourself when looking for a job

Do not limit yourself when looking for a job, in addition, your resume and your cover letters should reflect all your strengths and work achievements. Also, use strong, confident language when highlighting your qualities. Likewise, in job interviews, value and believe that you are the best candidate for the position and let your employer know.

Although sometimes the job search could become desperate due to debts or payments, try to acquire jobs that adapt to your talents. Thus, avoid working in jobs that are below your skills and abilities. Similarly, you deserve to work in a place where you are qualified that will challenge you and make you grow.

Additionally, keep in mind that you do not need to have 100% of the position profile since sometimes the list of requirements is longer than necessary. Therefore, if you meet at least half of these requirements, apply confidently. Likewise, when you are applying for a job, pay close attention to the treatment of the manager in charge of hiring.

Also, observe if they spend time without communicating or offer you a different job than the one offered at the beginning or less salary than agreed upon. This is an indication of the business culture that does not value the workforce they are hiring.

Give yourself the credit you deserve at work

Try to be kind to yourself and do not be humble when you excel in some activity at work. Also, accept the credit you will be given for it and demand it when you do not get it. Additionally, you should let your employer know that you will be proud of the work you did in a particular job activity.

Likewise, if a co-worker of yours wants to take full credit for work done together, make your employer aware of your involvement. Thus, do not steal the spotlight of anyone but assert yours. Additionally, this may mean requesting a salary increase if you believe it is necessary and deserves it. Hence, if you think you deserve 70% of the promotion, still feel free to apply for it.

Also, if you have earned it, let your boss know that you are a great fit for a position above yours that has recently opened up. Likewise, do not pass up the opportunity to tell him about the successes you have had and the good things you have done in your previous jobs.

However, if the company does not take into account your good work at work very often, it is time to think about another job.

Respect for local customs in Salary discussions

You can check salary online UAE when requesting any change in salary but remember the respect to do so. Furthermore, it is important to keep in mind that the Emirate is an Islamic country, and therefore the entire business culture is more conservative. In contrast to the ones in Europe and the United States where they are usually more relaxed.

Navigating the Cultural Aspects of Salary Talks

In the UAE, the business culture is mostly family-oriented, which makes employers tend to take care of the employees of their companies. Consequently, companies will provide a series of social benefits for their workers. In addition, the labor law requires the following contributions:

  • 26% about the pension fund. In this case, the employee will give 15%, the employer 5%, and the rest the Emirati government.
  • Similarly, in social security, the employer will cover 12.5% or 15% if it is in Abu Dhabi and 5% of the employee.

However, the expatriate will not have to make any contribution towards the payment of social security. Another benefit provided by companies to their workers is medical insurance that frequently extends to family members.

On the other hand, the Emirati government currently supports women with employment solutions, thus promoting labor equality. In addition, in recent years it approved gender pay equality contemplated in articles 27 to 24 of the UAE labor legislation. With them, the government assures the protection of women in the country.

Consequently, in the Emirates, by doing the salary check UAE, you will be able to have a good income according to your studies, experience, and skills. Nevertheless, you must see how salaries are managed in the different emirates. Furthermore, to obtain the income appropriate to your position, you must give value to all your qualities without skimping.

Likewise, if you have questions about this, contact us and we will help you because we have a group of professionals trained to do so.

FAQs

How do I check my salary details in UAE online?

The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) lets you check your salary details online on their website or app.

Can I get a salary certificate in UAE?

You can get your salary certificate in UAE by requesting your employer and they will have it issued for you.

What documents do I need to check UAE salary status?

You will need your Emirates ID, labour card number, or employment contract details to access salary information through MOHRE or confirm payments via bank statements.

Is salary information stored with MOHRE or GDRFA?

Salary information is maintained by MOHRE through the Wage Protection System, while GDRFA handles residency matters and does not store employee salary payment records.

How often do companies in UAE pay salaries?

UAE labour laws require companies to pay monthly salaries to their employees. These wages should be transferred within 14 days using approved WPS channels.

How can I calculate my UAE salary after deductions?

You can calculate your salary by subtracting statutory deductions, such as unpaid leave adjustments, authorized recoveries, and pension if you are an eligible GCC nationals.

However, if the company does not take into account your good work at work very often, it is time to think about another job.

Respect for local customs in Salary discussions

You can check salary online UAE when requesting any change in salary but remember the respect to do so. Furthermore, it is important to keep in mind that the Emirate is an Islamic country, and therefore the entire business culture is more conservative. In contrast to the ones in Europe and the United States where they are usually more relaxed.

Navigating the Cultural Aspects of Salary Talks

In the UAE, the business culture is mostly family-oriented, which makes employers tend to take care of the employees of their companies. Consequently, companies will provide a series of social benefits for their workers. In addition, the labor law requires the following contributions:

  • 26% about the pension fund. In this case, the employee will give 15%, the employer 5%, and the rest the Emirati government.
  • Similarly, in social security, the employer will cover 12.5% or 15% if it is in Abu Dhabi and 5% of the employee.

However, the expatriate will not have to make any contribution towards the payment of social security. Another benefit provided by companies to their workers is medical insurance that frequently extends to family members.

On the other hand, the Emirati government currently supports women with employment solutions, thus promoting labor equality. In addition, in recent years it approved gender pay equality contemplated in articles 27 to 24 of the UAE labor legislation. With them, the government assures the protection of women in the country.

Consequently, in the Emirates, by doing the salary check UAE, you will be able to have a good income according to your studies, experience, and skills. Nevertheless, you must see how salaries are managed in the different emirates. Furthermore, to obtain the income appropriate to your position, you must give value to all your qualities without skimping.

Likewise, if you have questions about this, contact us and we will help you because we have a group of professionals trained to do so.

How do I check my salary details in UAE online?

The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) lets you check your salary details online on their website or app.

Can I get a salary certificate in UAE?

You can get your salary certificate in UAE by requesting your employer and they will have it issued for you.

What documents do I need to check UAE salary status?

You will need your Emirates ID, labour card number, or employment contract details to access salary information through MOHRE or confirm payments via bank statements.

Is salary information stored with MOHRE or GDRFA?

Salary information is maintained by MOHRE through the Wage Protection System, while GDRFA handles residency matters and does not store employee salary payment records.

How often do companies in UAE pay salaries?

UAE labour laws require companies to pay monthly salaries to their employees. These wages should be transferred within 14 days using approved WPS channels.

How can I calculate my UAE salary after deductions?

You can calculate your salary by subtracting statutory deductions, such as unpaid leave adjustments, authorized recoveries, and pension if you are an eligible GCC nationals.

title: Sick Leave in UAE
content:
Published On: April 25, 2025Updated On: November 6, 2025

Sick Leave in UAE As Per Labour Law: A Quick Guide 2025

When you’re not feeling your best, the last thing you want to worry about is company rules. That’s why understanding your rights of sick leave in UAE is so important. So you can focus on recovery, not red tape.

Starting a new job? Managing a team? Or just curious about your rights? This 2025 guide makes everything about sick leave simple. Covering topics from who gets paid time off to how to apply without stress. We’ve packed all the essential info into one easy read. Let’s go and understand in detail how many sick leaves per month in UAE you can avail of.

What Is Sick Leave and Why It Matters?

Sick leave lets you take time off when you’re unwell. The good news? You are allowed to do so without risking your job or paycheck. It’s a key workplace right designed to protect your health. Meanwhile keeping things fair for your employer.

Sick Leave UAE labour law 2025 ensures that employees get proper rest when they’re sick. But to benefit from it, one must know how it works – stick to a few simple rules. Remember that sick leaves are different from annual leave in UAE.

Who Can Take Sick Leave in the UAE?

Not everyone qualifies for paid sick leave in UAE right away. Here’s when you become eligible:

Eligibility Criteria

  • ✔️ You must complete your probation period.
  • ❌ During probation, you’re not entitled to paid sick leave.
  • ✅ After probation, you get up to 90 days of sick leave per year.

Let’s break that down:

Sick Leave Duration

 What You Get Paid

First 15 days

 Full salary
Next 30 days

Half salary
Last 45 days

Unpaid leave

If you have unused sick leave in UAE, you can use these leaves in case of illness in the future. However, use them before they expire.

Can You Take Sick Leave During Probation?

Yes, but there’s a catch. You can take time off if you get sick during probation. However, it will be counted as unpaid leave. Always inform your employer and submit a doctor’s note if your illness lasts more than 1-2 days.

UAE Sick Leave Process: A Step-by-Step Guide

Taking care of your health is essential. It is a matter of your well-being. But also for maintaining a safe workplace. Applying for a UAE sick leave involves a clear process governed by UAE labor laws and employer policies. Anyone can be eligible, either new to the workforce or simply needing a refresher. Below a detailed steps on how to properly apply for sick leave in the UAE.

1. Inform Your Employer Promptly

The first important step when feeling unwell is to inform your employer. Do so as soon as possible. Employees must notify their employer within 3 days of falling ill as per the UAE laws.

Your company’s internal policy may dictate who to contact. It could be your manager, supervisor, or HR department. Early communication shows professionalism and allows your employer to manage workloads during your absence.

2. Get a Medical Certificate

The next step is to visit a certified healthcare facility/medical professional. Obtain a medical certificate that outlines:

  • Your diagnosis
  • The severity of your condition
  • The number of days you need to rest or recover

This sick leave certificate in UAE acts as official documentation of your illness. It is a mandatory requirement for most sick leave applications in the UAE.

3. Fill Out a Sick Leave Application

Once you’ve received your medical certificate, complete your company’s sick leave application form. This form may be available through your HR portal or employee handbook. The application typically requires the following details:

  • Your full name and employee ID
  • Date of illness and duration of leave
  • A copy of your medical certificate
  • Contact information during your leave
  • Emirates ID or passport copy (if requested)

Submit the completed form with the supporting documents. Submit them to your HR department or designated supervisor for review.

4. Pay for Medical Certificate Attestation (If Needed)

You might be required to attest your medical certificate by the UAE Ministry of Health or another official body. This could happen in some cases when your leaves are extended. It confirms the medical documentation’s authenticity.

There may be a small fee for the attestation process. Be sure to retain the payment receipt. Your employer might require it for record-keeping or reimbursement purposes.

Know and apply for sick leave today if you get ill. Also, explore the paternity leave in the UAE application process with eligibility criteria here.

Why a Medical Certificate is Important

UAE employers need a medical certificate to approve sick leave for several reasons:

  • Confirms that the employee is genuinely unwell and unable to work.
  • Deters misuse of leave benefits by requiring official documentation.
  • Shields the employer from liability in case of health-related incidents during work hours.
  • Helps employers manage contagious illnesses in the workplace to prevent outbreaks.

How Much Will You Get Paid During Sick Leave?

The pay for sick leave depends on how many days you’ve already taken in the year:

Sick Leave Days Used

 Salary You Receive

Day 1–15

 100% of your monthly wage
Day 16–45

50% of your monthly wage
Day 46–90

0% (Unpaid)

Sick leave salary calculation in UAE is a must to know so you can claim your rights fairly.

Employee Duties During Sick Leave

If you’re taking time off due to illness, you also have a few simple responsibilities:

🔹 Your To-Do List as an Employee:

  • Inform your boss or HR within 3 days.
  • Submit a doctor’s note if requested.
  • Be honest about your condition.
  • Stay reachable if more details are needed.

What Must Employers Do

On the flip side, companies also have to keep things transparent and fair. They need to:

🔸 Employer Responsibilities:

  • Shared sick leave rules with all staff.
  • Review sick leave requests quickly.
  • Pay employees according to the law.
  • Keep clear records for future reference.

FAQs: Quick Answers

Q: Can I get a backdated medical certificate?
 A: You can avail of it only if you have a valid reason and see the doctor within a few days of your illness.

Q: What if I’m sick but don’t have a doctor’s note?
 A: Your employer allows short absences. But for anything longer, you’ll need official proof.

Q: Can mental health issues qualify for sick leave?
 A: Absolutely! Conditions like anxiety or burnout can qualify you for a sick leave. Just be sure you consult a licensed healthcare provider.

Final Thoughts: Protect Your Health, Know Your Rights

Sick leave isn’t just a policy; it’s your right. Not feeling well? Don’t hesitate to take the time you need. Protect your health and your paycheck when you follow the correct steps. Be it an employee wanting to rest or a manager handling requests, know how sick leave works. It ensures that everyone stays healthy and legally protected.

Hence, understanding the proper sick leave procedure allows the time to recover. It also builds trust and transparency between you and your employer. It’s a reminder to always keep copies of your medical documents. Notify your employer and follow up with HR. So everything is processed smoothly. Difficult to manage all yourself? Contact Ng Manpower, and we’ll assist you the best. Taking care of yourself is always the priority—just make sure you follow the right steps along the way!
